1_status_quo.label: Status Quo
1_status_quo.description: Keep all 5 properties; Scenic continues as STR

2_ltr_convert.label: LTR Convert
2_ltr_convert.description: Keep all 5; convert Scenic from STR to LTR at $3K/mo
2_ltr_convert.actions_required: Stop STR bookings; list Scenic as LTR via Shoreward; screen tenant; sign 12-month lease

3_sell_and_sp500.label: Sell Scenic + S&P 500
3_sell_and_sp500.description: Sell Scenic (~$441K net); deploy proceeds to S&P 500
3_sell_and_sp500.actions_required: List Scenic for sale; complete sale; pay capital gains + depreciation recapture; open brokerage; deploy lump sum
3_sell_and_sp500.note: Wins on pure mission-weighted math and 20-year compounding, but irreversible loss of waterfront asset and family vacation venue

4_sell_and_beach.label: Sell Scenic + Buy Beach House/Condo
4_sell_and_beach.description: Sell Scenic (~$441K net); buy $700K Jax Beach property with $300K down
4_sell_and_beach.actions_required: Sell Scenic; find beach property; secure investor mortgage; close; furnish; manage new asset
4_sell_and_beach.note: Negative cash flow driven by mortgage + HOA + coastal insurance. Only viable as pure lifestyle asset.

5_sell_and_mountain_str.label: Sell Scenic + Buy Mountain STR
5_sell_and_mountain_str.description: Sell Scenic (~$441K net); buy $600K Smokies cabin with $250K down
5_sell_and_mountain_str.actions_required: Sell Scenic; acquire mountain property; secure STR financing; furnish; establish STR operations (or manager)
5_sell_and_mountain_str.note: Trades one STR problem for another; active management; recession-vulnerable

6_ltr_convert_plus_sp500_stack.label: LTR Convert + S&P Stack (HYBRID — RECOMMENDED)
6_ltr_convert_plus_sp500_stack.description: Convert Scenic to LTR + auto-invest annual excess cash flow into S&P 500
6_ltr_convert_plus_sp500_stack.actions_required: Execute Scenario 2 (LTR convert); open brokerage; set up monthly auto-investment of ~$3,800/mo (~$46K/yr)
6_ltr_convert_plus_sp500_stack.recommendation_rationale: Highest 5-year net worth. Keeps all optionality (can pivot to Scenario 3 at 24-month checkpoint). Begins structural diversification. AI/recession resilient. Scenario 3 marginally wins mission score and 20-year compounding, but irreversible — Scenario 6 preserves the choice.
